target: What IS the Weight-and-Gradient Entity (Argon's 'Hilbert Holon' proposal, ARGON-INPUT.md in this folder): the council gives a point of view on what it is, before any round on what it can do. Five viewpoints define it and answer Argon's five open questions; three opposers attack the definition where a lens would lie.

voices.lens: A lens never lies: as defined, no cell's flip, colour or glint is bound to a real changing number in either host, so the entity is decoration until the minimum truthful telemetry per cell is named

The glasses-free 3D and frame-alternating stereo claims contradict round 1's evidence and 'intensity only goes down': without glasses or a rendering-path change there is no 3D on an LCD, and the default must be the no-flicker path
The Hilbert story is wrong or unproven: an order-2 Hilbert curve is a U of U's, not a three-lobed E, and the Four-Float mapping smuggles a fifth metric
